title: Pest Control Intern
text: You ended something smaller than your shoe. The audience is thrilled, in the strictly legal sense of the word.

title: Bulk Discount
text: Fifteen bodies. Somewhere an accountant just updated a spreadsheet with your name on it.

title: Participation Trophy
text: You died. On camera. In the tutorial wing. We are waiving the cleanup fee this once.

title: Emergency Contact
text: You teamed up. Statistically, one of you is the bait. Do not ask which.

title: Patent Pending
text: You invented something by doing the same reckless thing three times. Science!

title: Litterbug
text: Twenty objects hurled. The janitorial drones have filed a formal complaint.

title: Outsourcing
text: You convinced a member of staff to risk their life for you. They are not paid enough. They are not paid at all.

title: Going Down
text: You found the stairs and used them correctly on the first try. The bar remains on the floor.

title: Identity Crisis Resolved
text: You are now officially something. Whether it is something good is between you and the viewers.

title: Punching Up
text: You killed something that outranked you. Human Resources has been notified.
